title: Business Trainer – German-language Workshops (f/m/d)
description:
Deliver management workshops for German-speaking clients.

What you'll do
- Facilitate workshops on feedback, delegation and change
- Prepare materials and follow-up tasks

What you bring
- 3+ years as trainer or facilitator
- German at C1 level or higher is required, since all workshops and materials are in German
- Good English
